'''Rayne's Dune Sea Outfitters''' was a warehouse in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], that was run by [[Rayne]]. The warehouse catered to the local scouts and explorers, and casual visitors were discouraged from entering by a group of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] employed by Rayne, but any being who identified Rayne was allowed to enter. No one was allowed into the warehouse itself, as Rayne kept its contents a secret. She maintained a complete inventory on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and could call up any item in minutes. [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]] could also store their cargoes in the warehouse for a small fee, but Rayne insisted that her Rodian guards load and unload the cargo. The reason for the secrecy and security was that much of Rayne's business was with various criminal and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], as well as the shipment of goods for [[Brentaal's Wayward Children]]. Hidden behind a jumble of shipping crates Rayne kept a [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transmitter]], used to make sure she was up-to-date on her customers' needs and shipments.
